scientific_effect: The graph is not invalidated, but the affected runtime metadata cannot support a precision or physical-execution claim and is excluded from promotion.
repair: Declare task_cake_projection_precision null when no final route-selected projection nodes exist, preserve the graph, and export a new immutable runtime.
